SELECT 
  CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) AS ratio
FROM customers

SELECT CustomerID, Consumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE Date LIKE '2012%'
AND CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
ORDER BY Consumption ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(Consumption) / 12 AS AverageMonthlyConsumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME')
  AND Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'

SELECT 
  (SUM(CZK_consumption) - SUM(EUR_consumption)) AS consumption_difference
FROM
  (
    SELECT 
      SUM(yearmonth.Consumption) AS CZK_consumption
    FROM 
      customers
    JOIN 
      yearmonth ON customers.CustomerID = yearmonth.CustomerID
    WHERE 
      customers.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND yearmonth.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
      SUM(yearmonth.Consumption) AS EUR_consumption
    FROM 
      customers
    JOIN 
      yearmonth ON customers.CustomerID = yearmonth.CustomerID
    WHERE 
      customers.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND yearmonth.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
  ) AS subquery

SELECT 
  SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) AS Year,
  SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM 
  yearmonth
GROUP BY 
  SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4)
ORDER BY 
  TotalConsumption DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) || SUBSTR(Date, 5, 2) AS MonthYear, MAX(Consumption) AS PeakConsumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME')
AND Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
GROUP BY SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) || SUBSTR(Date, 5, 2)
ORDER BY PeakConsumption DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH SegmentConsumption AS (
  SELECT 
    c.Segment,
    SUM(y.C Consumption) AS AnnualConsumption
  FROM 
    customers c
  JOIN 
    yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE 
    SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
  GROUP BY 
    c.Segment
),
LowestConsumptionSegments AS (
  SELECT 
    c.Segment,
    SUM(y.C Consumption) AS AnnualConsumption
  FROM 
    customers c
  JOIN 
    yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE 
    SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    AND c.CustomerID IN (
      SELECT 
        CustomerID
      FROM 
        customers
      WHERE 
        CustomerID IN (
          SELECT 
            CustomerID
          FROM 
            yearmonth
          WHERE 
            SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
          GROUP BY 
            CustomerID
          HAVING 
            SUM(Consumption) = (
              SELECT 
                MIN(SUM(Consumption))
              FROM 
                yearmonth
              WHERE 
                SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
              GROUP BY 
                CustomerID
            )
        )
    )
  GROUP BY 
    c.Segment
)
SELECT 
  (s1.AnnualConsumption - s2.AnnualConsumption) AS Difference
FROM 
  SegmentConsumption s1
JOIN 
  SegmentConsumption s2 ON s1.Segment = 'SME' AND s2.Segment = 'LAM'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  (s1.AnnualConsumption - s2.AnnualConsumption) AS Difference
FROM 
  SegmentConsumption s1
JOIN 
  SegmentConsumption s2 ON s1.Segment = 'LAM' AND s2.Segment = 'KAM'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  (s1.AnnualConsumption - s2.AnnualConsumption) AS Difference
FROM 
  SegmentConsumption s1
JOIN 
  SegmentConsumption s2 ON s1.Segment = 'KAM' AND s2.Segment = 'SME'

WITH yearly_consumption AS (
  SELECT 
    CustomerID,
    SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) AS Year,
    SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
  FROM yearmonth
  GROUP BY CustomerID, SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4)
),
eur_customers AS (
  SELECT 
    CustomerID,
    TotalConsumption
  FROM yearly_consumption
  WHERE CustomerID IN (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM customers
    WHERE Currency = 'EUR'
  )
),
segment_consumption AS (
  SELECT 
    c.Segment,
    eur_customers.CustomerID,
    eur_customption.TotalConsumption,
    eur_customption.Year
  FROM eur_customers
  JOIN customers c ON eur_customers.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
),
change_in_consumption AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.Segment,
    sc.CustomerID,
    sc.Year AS Year,
    sc.TotalConsumption AS Consumption,
    LEAD(sc.TotalConsumption, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY sc.CustomerID ORDER BY sc.Year) AS NextYearConsumption
  FROM segment_consumption sc
),
percentage_change AS (
  SELECT 
    Segment,
    CustomerID,
    Year,
    (NextYearConsumption - Consumption) / NULLIF(NextYearConsumption, 0) * 100 AS PercentageChange
  FROM change_in_consumption
  WHERE Year = '2012'
),
segment_percentage_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    Segment,
    AVG(PercentageChange) AS AvgPercentageChange
  FROM percentage_change
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT 
  Segment,
  AvgPercentageChange,
  CASE 
    WHEN AvgPercentageChange = (SELECT MAX(AvgPercentageChange) FROM segment_percentage_changes) THEN 'Biggest'
    WHEN AvgPercentageChange = (SELECT MIN(AvgPercentageChange) FROM segment_percentage_changes) THEN 'Lowest'
  END AS IncreaseType
FROM segment_percentage_changes
ORDER BY 
  CASE 
    WHEN AvgPercentageChange = (SELECT MAX(AvgPercentageChange) FROM segment_percentage_changes) THEN 1
    WHEN AvgPercentageChange = (SELECT MIN(AvgPercentageChange) FROM segment_percentage_changes) THEN 2
  END

SELECT 
  (y2012.Consumption - y2013.Consumption) / y2012.Consumption AS ConsumptionDecreaseRate
FROM 
  yearmonth y2012
JOIN 
  yearmonth y2013
ON 
  y2012.CustomerID = y2013.CustomerID
WHERE 
  y2012.Date = '201208'
  AND y2013.Date = '201308'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
      AND t.Amount * t.Price = 634.8
  )

SELECT 
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN g.Segment = 'Premium' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_premium

SELECT

  Patient
JOIN 
  Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID

  Examination

AND `Examination Date` = '1993-11-12'

SELECT

   SUM(CASE WHEN Laboratory.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN Laboratory.`T-CHO` END)) / 
  SUM(CASE WHEN Laboratory.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN Laboratory.`T-CHO` END) AS decrease_rate
FROM 
  Patient
JOIN 
  Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE 
  Patient.Birthday = '1959-02-18'
  AND Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1981-11-01' AND '1981-12-31'

FROM Laboratory l
WHERE l.Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND l.GPT > 30
  AND l.ALB < 4

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM Examination
WHERE Thrombosis = 2
  AND `ANA Pattern` = 'S'
  AND `aCL IgM` > 1.2 * (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination)

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND l.Date LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND l.`T-BIL` < 2.0

SELECT AVG(Laboratory.ALB)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND Laboratory.PLT > 400

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient 
WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis = 'APS'

SELECT 
  ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(Patient.ID), 2) AS percentage_women
FROM 
  Patient
JOIN 
  Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE 
  strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Examination.Diagnosis LIKE '%RA%'

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA > 8.0 THEN 'Yes'
    WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA > 6.5 THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS UricAcidNormal
FROM 
  Patient p
JOIN 
  Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID

SELECT 
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'), 2) AS percentage
FROM 
  atom
JOIN 
  molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE 
  molecule.label = '+' 
  AND atom.element = 'cl'

SELECT 
  a.element AS toxicology_element
FROM 
  atom a
JOIN 
  molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE 
  m.label = '+'
  AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'

SELECT 
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN element = 'h' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(element)) AS hydrogen_ratio,
  m.label
FROM 
  atom a
JOIN 
  molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE 
  a.molecule_id = 'TR006'

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label = '-'
AND (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
) > 5

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dis ON c.district_id = dis.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
AND dis.A3 = 'East Bohemia'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT district.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district
JOIN client ON district.district_id = client.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY district.district_id
HAVING AVG(district.A11) > 6000 AND AVG(district.A11) < 10000

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (
    SELECT MAX(c2.birth_date)
    FROM client c2

AND c.A11 = (

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN account a ON c.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
AND c.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A2 = 'Sokolov'
)

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2 AS district_name
FROM client c
JOIN disp disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29'

WITH client_loan AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
  WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05' AND l.status = 'A'
),
account_balance AS (
  SELECT 
    t.account_id,
    t.date AS trans_date,
    t.balance
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.date BETWEEN '1993-03-22' AND '1998-12-27'
),
client_balance AS (
  SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN t.trans_date = '1993-03-22' THEN t.balance END) AS balance_1993_03_22,
    MAX(CASE WHEN t.trans_date = '1998-12-27' THEN t.balance END) AS balance_1998_12_27
  FROM account_balance t
  JOIN client_loan cl ON t.account_id = cl.client_id
  GROUP BY c.client_id
)
SELECT 
  ((balance_1998_12_27 - balance_1993_03_22) * 100.0 / balance_1993_03_22) AS increase_rate
FROM client_balance
WHERE balance_1993_03_22 IS NOT NULL AND balance_1998_12_27 IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT a.frequency AS account_type
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dis ON c.district_id = dis.district_id

AND dis.A11 BETWEEN 8000 AND 9000

SELECT A15 AS average_crimes
FROM district
WHERE district_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT district_id
    FROM account
    WHERE date >= '1997-01-01' AND date < '1998-01-01'
)
AND A15 > 4000

  account ON client.client_id = account.client_id

FROM account a
JOIN client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id

SELECT 
    c.client_id, 
    (JULIANDAY('now') - JULIANDAY(c.birth_date)) / 365 AS age
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    card ca ON d.account_id = ca.account_id
WHERE 
    ca.type = 'gold' 
    AND d.type = 'OWNER'
